purpose_context: This Wave A mission owns the reporting projection, metric semantics, query API, dashboard, accessible chart/table views, and synthetic normalized reporting fixtures. It consumes the P0 event envelope for planning and develops against P4-owned synthetic invoice, payment-allocation, client, project, and due-work snapshots until P5/P6 publish real producer contracts. It owns no invoice/payment lifecycle, scheduling decisions, foreign-exchange conversion, or source-domain mutation.
purpose_tldr: Build deterministic per-currency revenue, collections, outstanding, aging, forecast, client, project, and due-work analytics with accessible charts and tables.
